text: I am writing to bring to your attention a discrepancy in the reporting of my credit file by your bureau. The issue pertains to the account managed by BMI FINANCE INC, which is inaccurately listed as an auto loan by your agency. Upon reviewing my credit report, I have observed that XXXX ( XXXX ) is reporting the account type as an auto loan. This information is factually incorrect. The account in question is correctly identified as an " installment loan. '' However, the accurate account type should be a " Credit Sale Agreement. '' I understand the importance of maintaining accurate and up-to-date credit information, as it significantly affects my creditworthiness. Discrepancies like this can have adverse effects on my financial standing, and I believe it is imperative to rectify this error promptly. I kindly request that you investigate and rectify the account type misclassification at your earliest convenience. The accurate reporting of the account type is crucial for the integrity and accuracy of my credit file. As a consumer, I have the right to an accurate credit report, and I believe it is crucial to address discrepancies promptly. I appreciate your attention to this matter and your prompt resolution. If needed, I am willing to provide any additional documentation or information to support the correction of this error.

meta.issue: Problem with a company's investigation into an existing problem
